pattern: SELECT [A-Z]+ AS [A-Z] FROM [A-Z] AS [A-Z_0-9]+ ON ([A-Z_0-9]+).([A-Z_0-9]+) = ([A-Z]+).(ID|liked\_id) GROUP BY ([A-Z_0-9]+).ID HAVING COUNT(\*) >= 2
correction: Replace the table aliases and column names to match each other, ensure the correct foreign key is used for joining, and update the group by and having clauses accordingly.

metadata.description: This rule identifies join errors where the aliases of the tables involved in the join are not consistent or the foreign key used for joining is incorrect.
